title: Centered Kernel Distance: Dimension-Free Error Bounds for Comparing Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.33447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The asymptotic error of representational similarity metrics such as centered kernel alignment (CKA) and representational similarity analysis (RSA) has been well-characterized, but there are no realistic bounds on how estimates of representational similarity $\textit{simultaneously}$ depend on the number of sampled neurons ($N$) and experimental conditions ($M$). We study the natural metric counterpart of CKA and RSA, which we call the Centered Kernel Distance (CKD). We show that CKD admits an unbiased estimator, whereas several popular similarity measures including CKA have no unbiased estimator. Under mild assumptions, we show that estimation error of CKD decays in proportion to $1/M + 1/N$. Strikingly, the rate in this bound does not depend on the dimensionality of the space of experimental conditions. Thus, similarity estimation does not suffer from the curse of dimensionality, which plagues similar problems in high-dimensional stat

translated_title: 中心核距离：用于比较神经表征的无维度依赖误差界
translated_abstract: 中心核对齐（CKA）和表征相似性分析（RSA）等表征相似性度量的渐近误差已被充分刻画，但对于表征相似性的估计如何同时依赖于采样神经元数量（N）和实验条件数量（M），目前尚缺乏符合实际的误差界。我们研究了CKA和RSA的自然度量对应物，称之为中心核距离（CKD）。我们证明CKD存在无偏估计量，而包括CKA在内的几种流行的相似性度量则不存在无偏估计量。在温和的假设条件下，我们证明CKD的估计误差以 1/M + 1/N 的比例衰减。引人注目的是，该误差界中的收敛速率不依赖于实验条件空间的维度。因此，相似性估计不会受到维度灾难的影响，而维度灾难正困扰着高维统计中的类似问题。
tldr: 本文提出中心核距离（CKD）这一神经表征相似性度量，证明其存在无偏估计量且估计误差以 1/M + 1/N 的速度衰减，同时收敛速率与实验条件空间维度无关，从而克服了表征相似性估计中的维度灾难。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Centered Kernel Distance (CKD) for comparing neural representations, proving it admits an unbiased estimator with estimation error decaying as 1/M + 1/N at a rate independent of the dimensionality of the experimental condition space, thereby overcoming the curse of dimensionality in representational similarity estimation.
